notes.title: 🇵🇱 Celebrate Polish Constitution Days With Giants Uprising! 🇵🇱
notes.content:
[h3]🌿 The spring is here, and May 3rd is getting closer and closer - get ready to dive into the vortex of creativity to celebrate Polish gamedev![/h3]

[b]It was the third day of May of the year 1791[/b] when the Polish Constitution was signed. It was a modern constitution seeking to implement wide state reforms, advancing democratization of Poland, and including checks and balances and tripartite separation of powers. It was the first such document in Europe, and the [i]second[/i] in the world, following the American one from 1787. To this day, we're celebrating it as one of the [b]peak[/b] achievements of the [i]Age of Enlightenment[/i] in Poland and the foundations of Polish democracy. 

[hr][/hr]

☀️ While historically, 3 May is a very important holiday, we celebrate it in different ways. We quite often take advantage of the warm sun of May and spring in full bloom, lighting up that grill and gathering for a BBQ ♨️ We can't back this up with any scientific data, but this could be the period when most Polish gamers are finally touching grass!

Of course, each to their own, and if you need to take a break from the sun for a bit so you won't overheat, there are also many ways to celebrate indoors! 🥳

🕹️Once again, [b]Acram Digital[/b] is hosting [b]Polish Constitution Days[/b] on Steam to celebrate the rapidly growing Polish gamedev. There are many titles to choose from, and we're proud that [b]Giants Uprising[/b] is among them! Play it from [b]April 26th to May 3rd[/b] to celebrate the creativity of Polish game creators and check out other games to witness our creativity in its full extent! 🇵🇱

notes.title: A retro(funny)spective - 2018 vs. now
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there fellow gamers![/h2]

[h3]Today we want to share a special thing with you - a retrospective trailer![/h3]

We have our standards, so memes and metal are way to go, but apart from that...
...you can see a vast difference between the first iteration of our game, and it's current state.

We have put a lot of work and changed immense amount of things. We tried some new mechanics, different and more "grim dark" visual style, but one thing has not changed throughout the years:

[b]Your opinion is the most important thing for us.[/b] 

We may not be able to implement it right away every single time, and have to prioritize, but we always write it down and discuss internally!

YOU are our engine and make us proud to have such a big and creative community.

Now - take a look, have a laugh and see you on the battlefield!

[previewyoutube=7SNxY2UfIt4;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're reading this as someone new to our game - take a look at our other materials! You might like it. And if you do - consider smashing that [b]add to wishlist[/b] button or maybe even grab a copy!

notes.title: Giants Uprising - Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.2.1 is live![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35530428/b1835dfc450d445208f57b5b9fa43ce6682664b6.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [b]Walk replaced with run[/b] (that doesn't use stamina bar) by default.

[*] [b]Charge is now one button-press instead of two[/b] (no need to hold attack button to do so). 
Thus overall speed of the gameplay increased. No changes regarding stamina usage.

[*] [b]Default controls on gamepad changed[/b] (actions mentioned above taken into account)

[*] [b]Level Design changes:[/b]
- the Player now faces correct direction when reloading the very last checkpoint
- issues regarding falling under the map have been fixed

[*] [b]Tutorial[/b] can be skipped now.

[*] [b]VSync[/b] has been implemented.

[*] [b]Lightning[/b] has been reworked on every map.

[*] Character models now interact with foliage.
[/olist]

We are greatful for your constant support, advice and requests both on social media and Steam Discussions alike. We're already planning the next update and we're always happy to get in touch with you, so do not hestitate to share your thoughts with us!

notes.title: One small step for a Giant | UPDATE 1.1.1

notes.content:
Dear Giants,

We are happy to finally release a 1.1.0 patch for Giants Uprising. We hope, that added functionalities will make the game more pleasurable and accessible for you, feel free to share your thoughts on our official Discord server. At this point, however, we would like to state, that not all of the functionalities promised in the roadmap are present in this update. This is mainly due to the fact, that for the past 3 weeks some members of our team and their families were dealing with Covid-19 and had to take care of their health. The health, comfort, and safety of our colleagues and their close ones are very important for us. This situation did affect our internal schedule, but nevertheless, we decided to publish the patch in a stable state, but without some functionalities or with some minor issues occurring. This way you, our Users, can enjoy more content in Giants Uprising, but we also want to be honest and we hope for your understanding. notes.content:
Dear Giants,

We are finishing our work on repairing the Save System, along with a few other optimisation issues and crashes. Tomorrow the patch will be published on Steam, however BEWARE - although this patch does fix some of the issues reported to us in the last two weeks, our changes to the Save System require erasing all of the User's current progress, as saves that were created beforehand are corrupted and will not cooperate with the new tweaks included in the patch, therefore this action is necessary to avoid any other potential issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 for Giants Uprising is now available
notes.content:
Dear Giants,

We are still solving the issues regarding optimization, we solved some of them, but due to the lack of possibility to perform proper compatibility tests, proper optimization process might take a little longer. If the game running on maximum graphics settings does not let you to fully enjoy the experience, we recommend going into the "options" sub-menu in order to lower the settings. We do understand, that this is only a half-measure, but we will do everything we can in order to replace it with proper solution as fast as possible.

Our tests also resulted in tracking down some issues regarding the various graphic cards, please make sure that:
- You are using the latest drivers for your graphic card
- You are using the latest DirectX
- (Laptops only) You are using a proper graphic card, not an integrated one

[i]Sorry for the troubles and thank you for your understanding and support.[/i]
